name: Victoria
message: 「Hiiigh, knock-knock~♪」

name: Shizuku
message: 「O-oh, hello... Thank you so much for inviting me here today...」
The two who appeared were Victoria and Shizuku.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, girls！ I’ve come to challenge the dojo~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey-hey-hey, I won’t let you do whatever you want on my turf！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If you’re looking to cause trouble, then, ah, you’ll have to go through me, Lady Setsugekka, first~~~！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Wha-oh♪ That’s Okita-kun, that’s Okita-kun’s famous line！ Kazamine-chan, you really get it~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehehe, since Victoria-senpai is such a big fan, I actually watched Okita-kun on Netflux.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And I ended up totally hooked！」

name: Victoria
message: 「So good！！ Let’s talk about Okita-kun later~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yahoo~, Shizuku-senpai, nice work, nice work~！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Y-yes, sorry for barging in...」

name: Iori
message: 「Thank you both for coming today.」
I thanked Victoria and Shizuku once more.

name: Momiji
message: 「Teacher, why did you invite Victoria and the others？」

name: Iori
message: 「I thought it might be good to hear from our seniors regarding the midterms.」

name: Iori
message: 「I figured it would be good to have an opportunity to ask about anything you’re anxious or curious about.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, that might actually be good.」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’d prefer a real fight over a Q&A session, though~. Hey, hey, does anyone want to spar？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes, yes! I want to do it!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I would also like a rematch.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-well now, let’s start with the midterms first...」

name: Victoria
message: 「Eh~, but I came here looking forward to a match!」

name: Victoria
message: 「The Martial Festival is getting close, so none of the third-year friends will spar with me at all~！」
With one month left until the Martial Festival, the third-years have entered the home stretch, focusing on final preparations and adjustments for their big moment.
They surely want to avoid any risks of mental fatigue or injury from sparring here.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, so that’s why you’re doing Dojo Crashing.」

name: Victoria
message: 「That’s right！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehehe, but Dojo Crashing brings back memories~. Reminds me of when I was in middle school.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Were you really doing Dojo Crashing？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ I’d jump into a dojo shouting ‘Tanomu！’, and lots of people would train me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh, some of those dojos must have been pretty rough, right？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Non, non, everyone was so good to me.」

name: Victoria
message: 「They were happy to see a foreign swordsman—it’s rare, after all—so everyone was so kind~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed, foreigners generally cannot wield Origami, so I believe it is very rare.」

name: Victoria
message: 「My mom is Japanese, you see, but at first I was so nervous.」

name: Victoria
message: 「I came to Nihon wanting to do Jindou, but I didn't know if I could activate Tenju.」

name: Victoria
message: 「The first time I held an Origami, I gripped it while shouting ‘Oh my gods！’」

name: Victoria
message: 「And then, the Origami really responded to me！ I was so happy~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see~. You must have loved Jindou enough to want to travel across the sea for it.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course! There’s nothing happier than being able to become like Okita-kun!」
While we were talking about that, Shizuku approached Setsugekka.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um… Setsugekka-san, there is something I would like to ask you…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, yes? What is it?」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Setsugekka-san, you possess a very rare power where your mental sensitivity increases when you become ferocious.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「If you don’t mind, would you please allow me to study it…？」
Shizuku’s eyes are sparkling.
Come to think of it, Shizuku had previously mentioned being interested in spiritual machinery, Tenju, gods, and Keyou.
To someone like her, Setsugekka might be a very intriguing subject.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Umm… Kei-chan, what should I do?」
That said, the secret art “Tamukai” is a strictly guarded matter for the Kazamine. Wouldn’t revealing it to Shizuku be...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, that’s fine. In fact, I would like to ask for it myself.」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, are you sure about this？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「There’s only a month left until the Martial Festival. The time for worrying about appearances has passed.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「At this point, I’ll use any means necessary. Even the smallest scrap of information would be a lead to control this runaway state.」
I see, so even the Kazamine family has made up their mind.

name: Iori
message: 「Understood. If that’s the case, I’ll help out too.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I’m counting on you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「With that said, I’d be grateful if you could investigate Setsugekka, provided we share our research data.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes, I don't mind sharing the data at all...」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I surmise that Setsugekka-san’s tendency to run wild during combat is a phenomenon similar to the trance state that priestesses fall into during divine possession rituals.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「If that’s the case, it’s possible that Setsugekka-san possesses traits of a shaman, a priestess, or a Saniwa, but do you have any prior research data on this...?」
She spoke at a rapid pace unlike her usual self.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That’s quite the keen insight. I’ll compile and send it to you later. Could you give me your contact ID?」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes... of course...」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Then, if I may, I’d like to begin by collecting data for when Setsugekka-san enters her runaway state...」

name: Iori
message: 「In that case, we should go to the training grounds instead of staying here.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If she runs wild here, it’s an automatic expulsion, after all~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't say such ominous things!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufufu, so Shizu is having a match with Kazamine-chan, huh? Well then, I’ll go have a match with someone else~！」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s true. Let’s all have some practice matches, then.」
I wanted to talk about the midterm exams, but... oh well. Matches with upperclassmen should also serve as preparation for the practicals.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay! I get to have a match!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright, alright, I’m going with Vicky-senpai.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ll go with Ririmu-san, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m going with Shizuku-san because I want to keep an eye on Setsugekka.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then I guess I’ll go that way too~」
Like that, we split into two groups and headed toward the indoor training grounds.
